nom: The INKEY List Hyaluronic Acid Hydrating Face Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one managing eczema, report the serum delivers noticeable, sometimes immediate hydration and eliminates dry or flaky patches with regular use; one calls it a bestseller especially recommended for dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation and good compatibility, including one prone to redness who had no side effects at all; one 46-year-old with sensitive, combination skin found it merely so-so with no wow factor and will not repurchase (3-star).
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as a routine staple that absorbs well without breakouts or pilling, including one whose combination skin turns dry in winter, while the same 46-year-old dissenting reviewer above found it unremarkable (3-star).
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin and occasional dry patches reports the serum hydrated just the areas that needed it while maintaining the rest, and another describes it as suited to oily and combination skin alike.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes it as a staple for her dry, mature skin, saying it leaves her skin looking perfectly plump.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines and less crepey texture after weeks to months of regular use, including one in her 40s managing fine lines and one in her 30s who says people now guess her age younger.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly report strong, often immediate hydration and plumping, with many calling it a long-term routine staple; one reviewer found it merely fine with no noticeable hydration difference, though she admits inconsistent use, and another separately noticed no plumping effect.
concerns.redness: One reviewer prone to redness and very sensitive skin reports no side effects at all, calling the water-based, fragrance-free formula reassuring.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer uses it specifically after retinol nights to support and protect her skin barrier with extra hydration.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report the serum hydrates without triggering breakouts, and others confirm it layers well without causing new blemishes or pilling.

aspects.libelle: Some reviewers notice no plumping effect

extraits.titre: I don't love it; it's just so-so
extraits.texte: I picked this up at Ulta, along with another hyaluronic acid serum. I have been using this one as of late as I am trying to find the perfect serum for me. I use the recommended pea-sized amount, morning and night, before my moisturizer. It's just ok—it doesn't really have a wow factor for me, so I won't be repurchasing. It's not a bad product; just not for me. For reference, I am 46 and have sensitive, combination skin.

Overall I'm happy with this product. I use it on a need basis, when my skin feels a bit dehydrated or after retinol nights to make sure I protect my skin barrier with hydration + moisture. Layers well with my gel moisturiser and SPF from another brand. Not sure about repurchasing but for those looking for an extra hydration step I do recommend.

I have very dry skin and use both this serum and the Ectoin Hydro-Barrier serum. I love both, but this one gives more immediate relief. I always go for the !00ml (or 100ml duo) because I can't get enough. I use this one after cleansing and then the Ection Hydro-Barrier serum both twice a day and it not only feels great, but the Hyaluronic acid is working for long-term improvement. It feels heavenly, massaging in the serum. Highly recommended, especially for people with dry skin.

Perfect in the sense of the absence of side-effects despite having a very sensitive skin. I'm really sensitive to UVs, my skin is really dry and i use to have redness. I'm using this product daily mixed with pure sesame oil before going to bed. Clearly largely water based, no smell, really reassuring, and has a positive impact on my skin without any side-effect whatsoever. Don't change the formula!

While I've been dealing with random dry patches on my otherwise oily skin, I've really gotten lots of help from this product in my routine. It has really helped hydrate the spots that need it and maintains the spots that are at my goal.

extraits.titre: A staple in mybskin care routine.
extraits.texte: Would never be without this. So hydrating, but not tacky at all. Leaves my dry, mature skin looking perfectly plump.
I got an acne prone skin and this serum moisturise my skin very well with out giving me any breakout.
